title: Two-coloring cubic graphs with small monochromatic components, but without singletons
summary: We combine two coloring aspects that work in opposite directions. One can 2-color the vertices of a cubic graph such that each monochromatic component is very small. One can also 2-color the vertices of a cubic graph such that each monochromatic component has degree at least 1. As an intended tool for solving a special case of Wegner's conjecture, Thomassen formulated a conjecture that combined the two previous properties. This led to the concept of a crumby coloring.
